tools.name: get-instructions
tools.description: Returns the ODocs.co integration guide as plain text: how patch positions and text anchors are matched, conflict detection with expectedVersion, document lifetime (temporary by default), error codes and rate limits. Relevant when working with an ODocs.co document link without other documentation.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create-document, get-document, list-comments, reply-to-comment, resolve-comment · Private data: create-document, get-document, patch-document, list-versions, get-version, get-instructions, list-comments, create-comment, reply-to-comment, resolve-comment · Public sink: create-comment · Destructive: get-document, patch-document, get-version, list-comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create-document, get-document, list-comments, reply-to-comment, resolve-comment · Private data: create-document, get-document, patch-document, list-versions, get-version, get-instructions, list-comments, create-comment, reply-to-comment, resolve-comment · Public sink: create-comment · Destructive: get-document, patch-document, get-version, list-comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
